responses.text: You come to the wrong place, traveler. Primm's dying. If you got any sense, you'll be moving on.
Quite a town we got here. Sheriff gets murdered, and Deputy Beagle dragged off for ransom to the Bison Steve. That should bring back the tourists.
Rather be left alone to my misery, if you don't mind.
Before the Powder Gangers came to town, Johnson Nash ran the local store and the Mojave Express station.
I ain't got nothing for you to eat. If you're hungry, see Ruby Nash.
Thanks for freeing the deputy. A bit, anyway.
Thanks for freeing Deputy Beagle. He's better than nothing. Maybe.
Now you freed Deputy Beagle, all Primm needs is a law man who can shoot a gun without wetting hisself.
I hear you're going to help find Primm a new sheriff. Mighty kind of you to take an interest.
So you're the one's going to bring the law back to Primm? I'll believe it when I see it.
I hear you aim to bring rule of law back to our town. God knows we need the help.
Thanks for bringing the NCR to town, stranger. Things're finally looking up for Primm.
Thanks to you I got a mess of soldiers watching every move I make, plus I got to pay taxes for the privilege!
Those soldiers you brought down on us is all business, stranger. Better than lawlessness, though. So you've got my thanks.
This new Sheriff Meyers you brought to us is a lawman through and through. Primm's looking up, stranger.
Thanks for convincing Meyers to come sheriff for us. First time I feel safe in a long time.
This Sheriff Meyers you found for us is working out. Knows his business. We owe you a debt.
We'd be the last to know.
I hope they do, but I haven't heard nothing.
Your guess's as good as mine. Probably better.

topics.prompt: Any idea what the NCR's up to in Primm?
